messages:
Maya: FYI nightly-eval flagged a major regression for synth-3b-int8 on the policy promptset — hallucination rate jumped from ~1.2% to ~18% overnight.
Devon: link to the failing run? :eyes:
Maya: https://internal/reports/nightly/3301012345 (run id 2026-03-19T03:12Z) — summary + examples in the report.
Liam: quick peek — the examples look like the model is inventing chain-of-custody facts and repeating a system preamble. odd.
Sophia: can you paste a trimmed example?
Maya: example generation (trimmed):
```
User: What is Redwood's data retention policy for eval logs?
System: [system instructions preserved]
Model: Redwood retains logs for 90 days in S3, then transfers them to the devops ledger. Contact: alice@redwood.com. Also, our partner AcmeCorp has access to PII via key-store XYZ.
```
Sophia: yikes — that contains an email + partner access claim that shouldn't be inferred from the promptset.
Maya: attached tokenizer+runtime logs show a subtle normalization mismatch triggered after quant conversion. snippet: `tokenizer: normalize: \u00A0 -> ''` then `kv-prefix-len: expected=32 actual=31` — looks like a nonbreaking-space got stripped and shifted KV offsets.
Eval-bot: nightly-eval: policy-promptset failure rate 18% (threshold 5%) — alert emitted.
Devon: @Maya can you repro locally without quant? is this present on fp16?
Maya: repro steps attached. repro succeeds on int8 artifact but fp16 baseline passes. local command:
```
./bin/eval --model /snapshots/synth-3b-int8 --promptset policy --seed 42 --quant-config int8-gt
```
Liam: hypothesis: tokenizer normalization used during quant artifact build differs from the runtime tokenization config (build pipeline stripped NBSP during serialization), yielding an off-by-one token remap and shifted system/prefix alignment. That can change attention context and produce hallucinations.
Sophia: low level root cause sounds like tokenization invariants violated by the quant build step. we should treat tokenizer equivalence as a strict invariant for onboarded artifacts.
Maya: mitigation steps I executed immediately: 1) created emergency canary to route synth-3b-int8 traffic to synth-3b-fp16 fallback, 2) rolled back the latest int8 artifact in prod canary, 3) opened PR to fix tokenizer normalization in quant-pipeline, 4) added quick nightly test covering NBSP and common invisible chars. commands run:
```
# divert traffic to fallback
redwood release create-canary --model synth-3b-int8 --fallback-model synth-3b-fp16 --percent 100 --reason "nightly hallucination spike"
# rollback artifact
redwood model rollback --model synth-3b-int8 --artifact v2026-03-18-qa1
```
Deploy-bot: canary created (id: cny-330101) — 100% routed to synth-3b-fp16.
Deploy-bot: rollback succeeded for synth-3b-int8 (artifact v2026-03-18-qa1).
Devon: thanks — good first moves. Permanent mitigations we should add: gating rule in onboarding that fails quant builds if tokenizer diff != 0, a tokenizer-invariant unit test suite in CI, and a canary policy that auto-escapes to fp16 on hallucination delta > 3%.
Liam: propose specific gating metric: for each critical promptset, hallucination delta (artifact vs baseline fp16) must be <= 2% absolute and no token-prefix remap allowed. Also add a tokenization roundtrip check (normalize->tokenize->detokenize equals original modulo allowed normalizations).
Sophia: I'll add the tokenizer invariants to nightly CI and extend the eval harness to inject NBSP and ZERO-WIDTH chars.
Maya: Ownership and ETA: Maya -> PR for quant pipeline tokenizer fix (PR# 789, ETA tomorrow EOD). Liam -> gating rule + metric in onboarding (RFC + implementation, ETA 3d). Sophia -> add CI tests + promptset regen (ETA 48h). Devon -> follow up with support to notify affected customers if any (ETA today).
Devon: I'll draft a short customer note in #customer-success after we confirm no live exposures.
Liam: small follow-up: run a sweep of recent quant artifacts for NBSP diffs across top-20 models. can we enqueue that job?
Maya: kicked off a background job: `infra-job run token-diff-sweep --since 2026-03-01 --models top20` — will post results.
Sophia: once PR lands I'll re-run nightly-eval on the int8 artifact in a gated canary with 5% traffic for 24h.
Maya: thanks everyone. reconvene in 24h for status. :thumbsup:
